name: 4855 College Ave
subtitle: 3.05-Acre Multifamily Development
overline-type: Full Offering Memorandum - presented to industry judges
description: A complete Offering Memorandum for a 3.05-acre site zoned single-family, with a proposed rezone to multifamily from RS-1-7 to RM-4-10. Presented at a UCSD Urban Planning EXPO with a charrette board and investor video pitch.
